subject: [PATCH v5 01/22] iomap: release the folio batch on iomap callback failures

reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: Also approved the patch and added a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-07-30.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug in the iomap folio batch mechanism, where it fails to release the batch on error scenarios. The fix involves updating the cleanup helper to clear the flag unconditionally and release the batch when populated. This change ensures that the I/O path is properly controlled and the status of the folio batch is maintained.
